title: Zero-hour daily ticklist
content:
2026-03-13 morning — quick brain-dump / running list

Top of mind (30m):
- 🚦 Quick health: run smoke-check script on staging (smoke-staging.sh) — note: DB migrations might slow first requests
- Confirm feature flag names with eng before canary: fw_flag = 'dedicated_v1_canary' (ask @Arjun)
- PRD edits: tighten success metrics section (sec 4) — replace vague ‘good uptake’ with: 95th pctl latency <= 220ms AND error rate < 0.5% for baseline model.

Morning TODOs (priority order):
1) PRD: inline examples for fallback behavior (sec 2.3). Add small sequence showing model fallback from 'redwood-3b-q' -> 'redwood-2.7b' and expected token deltas. (owner: Maya)
2) Follow-ups: Slack @Arjun (infra), @Leah (SRE), @Tom (data) re: canary CPU headroom. Ask: will autoscaler allow 20% burst?
3) Jira: triage REDW-2148 (observability missing span IDs during streaming). Add acceptance criteria: span id present per chunk.
4) Quick write for launch checklist -> handoff to SEs by EOD.

Notes from sync with Eng (9:00):
- Kernel change on 3/11 moved quantization path — may affect perf on seq len > 1024. Need perf table in PRD appendix. Action: eng to provide new perf numbers by Fri.
- Autoscaler now exposes 'burst-reserve' knob but default is off. Leah to enable for canary window.

Stakeholder follow-ups: 
- PM partner: send short TL;DR + 3 asks to Growth (copy below).
- Legal: ping for DPA checklist re data residency for Private trial customers. (link to legal checklist in linked_artifacts)

Launch quick checklist (condensed) — copy to final checklist doc:
- [ ] Feature flag created + tested in staging
- [ ] Canary policy configured (traffic %, duration)
- [ ] Monitoring dashboards: latency hist, token cost, errors by model variant
- [ ] Alerts: p50/p95 spike, error rate threshold, rollout abort on >1% errors for 5m
- [ ] Fallback model available and smoke-tested
- [ ] Rollback playbook + contact list shared with SEs
- [ ] Post-launch eval: sample prompt set (100 prompts) + automated regression run (link: github PR in linked_artifacts)

Copy draft for Growth Slack: 
"Hey Growth — quick heads up: new Dedicated canary today. 3 asks: (1) hold new customer signups to beta list; (2) report any error/latency issues in #prod-incidents; (3) keep any A/B tests paused for 24h. Will follow with short postmortem"

Open questions / TODOs to resolve: 
- Can we set per-tenant cache TTLs for prefix caching? (email infra@redwood)
- Need quantized model size on GPU for on-prem packaging — new report from infra?
- Decide on rollback threshold: 1% vs 0.5% — SRE preference was conservative; prefer 0.5% for first canary.

Quick patch notes to PRD (editable bullets):
- Add explicit rollback thresholds and who approves (PM -> SRE lead -> Eng manager)
- Add canary schedule table (timezone aware)
- Add short troubleshooting section: common failure modes + first-check commands

Personal notes / reminders to self: 
- Take lunch break (12:30) — block calendar 30m
- Follow up with Leah about alert noise tuning before canary
- Draft runbook items tonight so SEs can rehearse tomorrow

Recent links / artifacts referenced (copy to final):
- Jira REDW-2148, REDW-2201
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1487
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01ABCXYZ/p1650000000000
- Legal checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Legal/DPA-checklist

End of morning dump — will prune into formal checklist and PRD edits after lunch.

-- maya
